text:
Berwyn one of 28 cities tied for 30th in Illinois with 3 scam reports in July
F. G. Murphy
Berwyn logged three scam reports in July 2026, placing it among 28 cities tied for 30th out of 282 Illinois cities with at least one Better Business Bureau Scam Tracker report.
That was up from one report in the previous month.
Reports listing dollar amounts in the city totaled $3,080 in July 2026; two reports mentioned a loss. Employment-related scams were the most common, accounting for two of the reports.
The largest reported loss for the month was $80 tied to an online purchase scam. One report said a consumer ordered two sweaters but received two lower-quality blouses, and the business refused both a return and a full refund.
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their experiences to help others spot similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to show large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
